Granny and the Gators owner strategy

strategy.summary: Enter a pinball detour, collect AMMO and Power Paddle, qualify an Extra Canoe when the hoop is safe, then complete EXIT and return to the river with stored resources.

quickInfo.name: Video Phase
quickInfo.summary: Steer the canoe, spend Shots on hazards, collect Gold, and enter pinball detours from the river.

quickInfo.name: Pinball Phase
quickInfo.summary: One physical ball earns resources until a drain or lit EXIT saucer returns play to the river.

quickInfo.name: Power Paddle
quickInfo.summary: Complete POWER and shoot the saucer to store a timed stronger paddle for video play.

quickInfo.name: Extra Canoe
quickInfo.summary: Roll over all eight center buttons, then shoot the lit saucer to add one canoe after the regular turn.

steps.text: In the Video Phase, use short paddle taps to steer toward a pinball entrance.
Enter the pinball entrance. Complete A-M-M-O once for five Shots.
modeNotes: Pinball Phase: One physical ball earns resources until EXIT or a drain returns play to the river.
Shots: A-M-M-O stores ammunition; either fire button spends one Shot against a gator or spear-thrower.

steps.text: Complete the five P-O-W-E-R drops. Shoot the saucer while Power Paddle is lit.
modeNotes: Power Paddle: POWER and the saucer store a timed stronger video paddle; press the center button when it flashes.

steps.text: During the river phase, use Power Paddle to pass green gators and gain speed. Save Shots for blocking hazards.
On another pinball visit, repeat the top-right hoop and collect all eight center rollover lights.
modeNotes: Extra Canoe: Eight center rollover lights qualify it; the lit saucer stores one added canoe for play after the regular turn.

steps.text: Shoot the saucer while Extra Canoe is lit.
Complete E-X-I-T when you are ready to return to the river. Shoot the saucer while EXIT is lit.
modeNotes: EXIT: Completing E-X-I-T lights the saucer; collection ends the current Pinball Phase and resumes the Video Phase.

steps.text: Use fire buttons only when a gator or spear-thrower blocks the route, and collect Gold before toll routes.

fallback.title: AMMO and EXIT
fallback.when: Use this when POWER drops or the hoop return are unsafe.

steps.text: Complete A-M-M-O once for five Shots.
Complete E-X-I-T.
Shoot the saucer while EXIT is lit.
Conserve Shots until a hazard blocks the river route.
Enter another pinball detour before ammunition reaches zero.

alternatives.title: Extra Canoe loop
alternatives.when: Use this when the top-right hoop returns safely to a flipper.

steps.text: Shoot the hoop and read the flashing center rollover.
Roll through the flashing button and repeat the hoop.
Roll over all eight center buttons.
Shoot the lit Extra Canoe saucer.
Complete EXIT and return to video play.

alternatives.title: Power Paddle river route
alternatives.when: Use this when POWER is safer than AMMO and the video controls feel predictable.

steps.text: Complete P-O-W-E-R and shoot the lit Power Paddle saucer.
Complete E-X-I-T and shoot the lit EXIT saucer.
Press the center button when Power Paddle flashes.
Use the added thrust to pass green gators and save Shots for later hazards.

buildsToward.title: More canoes with stored river resources

steps.text: Complete A-M-M-O for Shots.
Complete P-O-W-E-R and collect Power Paddle.
Use the hoop to light all eight center rollovers.
Collect Extra Canoe at the saucer.
Complete EXIT and return to the river.
Use Shots, Gold, and Power Paddle to protect the current canoe.

cautions.issue: Green gators can bite a normal paddle.
cautions.response: Use Power Paddle and point it toward the gator while the feature is active.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm switches 6, 8, 15, and 24 for hoop qualification, feature memory, Extra Canoe, and award behavior.
Dynamite's effect and input are unconfirmed, so leave it out of the scoring plan.
Test all buttons, video steering, AMMO, POWER, hoop, eight rollovers, EXIT, and saucer priority before choosing a resource route.
strategy.simpleOverview: Granny and the Gators alternates video river travel with short pinball detours that supply Shots, Power Paddle, and extra canoes. Enter pinball, spell A-M-M-O and P-O-W-E-R, use the hoop to collect all eight center rollovers, then shoot the lit saucer for Extra Canoe before completing E-X-I-T.
strategy.overview: Granny and the Gators alternates video river travel with short pinball detours that supply Shots, Power Paddle, and extra canoes. Complete A-M-M-O for Shots, complete P-O-W-E-R and collect Power Paddle at the saucer, then use repeated hoop shots to roll over all eight center buttons and collect Extra Canoe. Complete E-X-I-T when the needed resources are stored, then spend Shots only on blocking hazards during the river.
